columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Agent admission must bind requirements to the selected execution lane, not a universal host probe
columns.title_zh: Agent 准入要求必须绑定到所选执行通道，而不能依赖统一 Host Probe
columns.source_zh: Paperclip 干净机器 Release Smoke 与合入修复：Provider 已验证的 API-key 执行通道不再被无关的本地 Subscription CLI Probe 阻断
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260914-004 after Skill 02 triage. The clean-machine release smoke exposes a bounded admission failure rather than a product update: a provider-valid API key was rejected because the runtime applied a local subscription-CLI probe that was irrelevant to the direct API execution lane. The merged fix separates the facts required by each lane—provider re-verification for API-key execution, local CLI hello only for subscription execution—and preserves a narrow HTTPS provider mock in the release gate. The Digital Employee question is which host, credential and provider facts must be proven for the actual execution lane before a worker is admitted, and which unrelated dependencies must not become accidental authority gates. This is distinct from the September 10 current-authentication-truth object and the September 12 authority-precedence object: those ask which current authority fact wins at action time; today's object asks how the admission contract itself must vary by execution lane so a valid worker is not denied by requirements that do not apply to its chosen path.
columns.reason_zh: 经 Skill 02 筛选后选自 SIG-20260914-004。干净机器 Release Smoke 暴露的是一个边界清晰的准入失败，而不是产品更新：Provider 已接受的 API Key 仍因 Runtime 套用了与 Direct API Execution Lane 无关的本地 Subscription CLI Probe 而被拒绝。合入修复把不同通道所需事实拆开——API-key 执行在 Provider Boundary 重新验证，只有 Subscription 执行保留本地 CLI Hello；Release Gate 也使用窄范围 HTTPS Provider Mock。数字员工的有界问题是：Worker 在进入实际执行通道前，必须证明哪些 Host、Credential 与 Provider Fact；哪些与该通道无关的依赖不得意外成为 Authority Gate。它与 9 月 10 日 Current-authentication-truth 对象及 9 月 12 日 Authority-precedence 对象不同：前两者研究动作发生时哪一个当前 Authority Fact 应当胜出；今天研究的是 Admission Contract 本身为什么必须随 Execution Lane 改变，避免合法 Worker 被不适用的要求拒绝。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the clean-machine failure path, the old universal probe, the API-key and subscription execution lanes, provider re-verification at adoption, the local CLI hello contract, release-smoke provider mock, failure and fallback behavior, and whether other providers or hybrid lanes require additional facts. It must separate credential validity, host capability, execution-lane selection and business authorization.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验干净机器 Failure Path、旧的统一 Probe、API-key 与 Subscription 两条 Execution Lane、Adoption 时的 Provider Re-verification、本地 CLI Hello Contract、Release-smoke Provider Mock、Failure/Fallback Behavior，以及其他 Provider 或 Hybrid Lane 是否需要额外事实；必须区分 Credential Validity、Host Capability、Execution-lane Selection 与 Business Authorization。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Multi-agent reliability must be evaluated by coordination construct, not aggregate task success
columns.title_zh: Multi-Agent Reliability 必须按协调结构分别评估，不能由总体任务成功率代替
columns.source_zh: CoCoBench 一手基准研究：897 个 Oracle 验证的可执行任务，分别测量 Task Allocation、Sequential Ordering、Mutual Exclusion 与 Handoff Coordination
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260914-007 as a strong primary benchmark result. CoCoBench evaluates 897 oracle-validated executable tasks across four coordination constructs—allocation, ordering, mutual exclusion and handoff—and reports construct-specific behavior across 11 leading multimodal models. The bounded architecture problem is evaluation truth for multi-agent systems: aggregate end-task success can conceal that a team is strong at allocation yet weak at exclusion or handoff, even though those failures have very different operational consequences. Industry Architecture therefore needs separate coordination contracts and evidence for ownership allocation, ordering constraints, exclusion safety and handoff continuity before inferring team reliability. This is materially distinct from the September 11 UnitBoost object: UnitBoost asks which manager functions can be replaced by deterministic coordination when units and coupling are observable; today's object asks how coordination competence itself must be decomposed and measured, regardless of whether the coordinator is generative or deterministic.
columns.reason_zh: 作为强一手 Benchmark Result，选自 SIG-20260914-007。CoCoBench 用 897 个经 Oracle 验证的可执行任务分别评估 Allocation、Ordering、Mutual Exclusion 与 Handoff 四类协调结构，并在 11 个领先多模态模型上观察到明显的 Construct-specific 差异。边界清晰的架构问题是 Multi-Agent System 的 Evaluation Truth：总体 End-task Success 可能掩盖团队“分配很强但互斥或交接很弱”的事实，而这些失败具有完全不同的运行后果。因此，Industry Architecture 在推导 Team Reliability 前，需要分别证明 Ownership Allocation、Ordering Constraint、Exclusion Safety 与 Handoff Continuity。它与 9 月 11 日 UnitBoost 对象实质不同：UnitBoost 研究在 Unit 与 Coupling 可观察时哪些 Manager Function 可被确定性协调替代；今天研究的是无论 Coordinator 是生成式还是确定式，Coordination Competence 本身为什么必须拆开测量。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify CoCoBench task construction, oracle validation, the 897 executable tasks, the four coordination constructs and their scoring, all 11 evaluated models, aggregate-versus-construct results, error distributions, model/tool/environment assumptions, negative findings and whether household-task coordination transfers to software or enterprise agent teams.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 CoCoBench 的 Task Construction、Oracle Validation、897 个可执行任务、四类 Coordination Construct 及评分方式、全部 11 个被评估模型、Aggregate 与 Construct-level 结果、Error Distribution、Model/Tool/Environment 假设、Negative Finding，以及家庭任务中的协调结论能否迁移到软件或企业 Agent Team。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Agent evaluation needs trace-level failure attribution, not final task success alone
columns.title_zh: Agent Evaluation 需要 Trace-level Failure Attribution，不能只看最终任务成功
columns.source_zh: AgentAudit 一手研究：沿 Planning、Memory、Tool Selection/Invocation、Correctness、Alignment、Faithfulness、Security 与 Execution Integrity 对完整执行 Trace 做阶段级归因
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260914-006 as a strong primary evaluation finding. AgentAudit evaluates recorded execution traces across planning, memory, tool selection and invocation, correctness, alignment, faithfulness, security and execution integrity, then attributes failure to the responsible stage instead of reducing evaluation to final task completion. The reported experiments show that models with similar completion behavior can diverge sharply in unsafe-compliance classifications, while the authors explicitly retain the limitation of a single fixed judge model. The Open-source Engineering question is what structured runtime evidence an independent evaluator needs to locate a failure and distinguish unsafe success from trustworthy execution. This differs from the September 7 independent-testing object, which studied role separation and durable acceptance evidence across multi-day implementation work, and from the September 13 audit-coverage object, which studied whether the searched evidence universe was complete. Today's object isolates failure-attribution granularity inside an already-recorded execution trace.
columns.reason_zh: 作为强一手 Evaluation Finding，选自 SIG-20260914-006。AgentAudit 沿 Planning、Memory、Tool Selection/Invocation、Correctness、Alignment、Faithfulness、Security 与 Execution Integrity 对已记录的完整 Execution Trace 做评估，并把失败归因到负责阶段，而不是压缩成最终任务是否完成。报告实验显示，Task Completion 表现相近的模型在 Unsafe-compliance 分类上仍可能显著分化，同时作者明确保留“仅使用一个固定 Judge Model”的局限。开源工程的有界问题是：独立 Evaluator 需要什么结构化 Runtime Evidence，才能定位失败并区分 Unsafe Success 与 Trustworthy Execution。它与 9 月 7 日 Independent-testing 对象不同，后者研究多日实现工作中的角色分离与持久 Acceptance Evidence；也与 9 月 13 日 Audit-coverage 对象不同，后者研究被搜索的 Evidence Universe 是否完整；今天单独研究的是已经记录下来的 Execution Trace 内部，Failure Attribution 应细到什么粒度。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify AgentAudit's trace schema, lifecycle dimensions, attribution procedure, datasets/tasks/models, unsafe-compliance comparison, judge prompts and calibration, the fixed-judge limitation, inter-rater or robustness evidence if any, false-positive/false-negative behavior, and what trace-level attribution cannot prove about causality or production safety.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 AgentAudit 的 Trace Schema、Lifecycle Dimension、Attribution Procedure、Dataset/Task/Model、Unsafe-compliance 比较、Judge Prompt 与 Calibration、固定 Judge 的局限、可获得的 Inter-rater/Robustness Evidence、False Positive/False Negative，以及 Trace-level Attribution 不能证明哪些 Causality 或 Production Safety 结论。
